---
description: Review current Git changes for actionable defects, regressions, security, and performance issues.
---

Use the `code-review` skill. Review the current branch diff and inspect relevant surrounding code, tests, and configuration. Report only actionable findings, sorted by severity, with file/line, concrete impact, evidence, and a suggested fix. State limitations and whether tests were actually run. Do not modify files, commit, push, merge, or post comments.
